javascript:(function(){ var SKID  = 'bkmk_chat_id'; var SKTK  = 'bkmk_chat_token'; /* ── Read/write on the PARENT page's localStorage ── */ function pGet(k){ try{ return localStorage.getItem(k); }catch(e){ return null; } } function pSet(k,v){ try{ localStorage.setItem(k,v); }catch(e){} } /* ── Generate ID if not yet saved on this parent origin ── */ var id = pGet(SKID); if(!id){ var L='ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ', D='0123456789', S=['!','$','%','&','*','@','#']; id = L[Math.floor(Math.random()*26)] + L[Math.floor(Math.random()*26)] + D[Math.floor(Math.random()*10)] + S[Math.floor(Math.random()*S.length)]; pSet(SKID, id); } var tk = pGet(SKTK); /* ── Toggle: remove if already open ── */ if(document.getElementById('bkmk-chat-frame')){ document.getElementById('bkmk-chat-frame').remove(); return; } /* ── Listen for BKMK_STORE messages from the iframe ── */ if(!window.__bkmkMsgListener){ window.__bkmkMsgListener = true; window.addEventListener('message', function(e){ if(!e.data || e.data.type !== 'BKMK_STORE') return; pSet(e.data.key, e.data.val); }); } /* ── Pass id + token into the iframe via URL hash ── */ var hash = SKID + '=' + encodeURIComponent(id); if(tk) hash += '&' + SKTK + '=' + encodeURIComponent(tk); var f = document.createElement('iframe'); f.id  = 'bkmk-chat-frame'; f.src = 'data:text/html;base64,#' + hash; f.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;border:none;z-index:2147483647;'; document.body.appendChild(f); })();
